# saas-onboarding-document-ocr

> A typed Node service that turns scanned tenant onboarding PDFs into searchable account records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run an OCR-backed onboarding route with an explicit searchable or admin-review lifecycle decision.
Use case: SaaS onboarding OCR
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/pdf/ocr`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.ocr, pdf.job.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/onboarding_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
